seo: Etsy shipping profiles and delivery times
meta: Etsy shipping profiles, processing times and rates set up so buyers see correct costs. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Etsy shipping profiles, set up the right way
overview: Wrong shipping settings cost sellers money. We check your Etsy shipping profiles against your real carrier prices, processing times and package sizes, then set up profiles for each product type. That covers domestic and international rates, free shipping thresholds, handling time and the delivery estimates buyers see. We apply them to your listings in bulk and test a few checkouts, and give you a simple rate sheet.

Customs and delivery notes for buyers

faq: Do you know my carrier prices?
We use the prices you send us or the Etsy shipping label prices for your parcel sizes. If you ship by hand with another carrier, send a rate card or a recent invoice, and we match it.
Not in this service. We set up profiles and rates only. Label buying is part of order management, which we offer separately.
Yes. We work out a threshold from your product prices, parcel weights and margins, and tell you what each choice would cost you per order, so you pick it with real figures.
What about customs and international sales?

We add the delivery estimates and customs notes Etsy asks sellers to show, and explain duties in plain words to your buyers. Rules vary by country, so confirm tax and duty rules with your own adviser.
